method: Independent multinomial resampling of calibration and test records; pairs of distinct original record IDs weighted by multiplicity products; self-copy pairs excluded; percentile 95% intervals. Calibration weighted quantiles use inverse ECDF; reported point uses original linear quantile.
conditional: Same test-record counts at the original fixed threshold, for comparison with joint resampling.
limitation: Record bootstrap assumes exchangeable records; it does not model source-group dependence. Bootstrap positive fraction is descriptive, not a p-value. Pointwise intervals; no multiplicity correction.
